title: IEFBR14 allocating a data set by DISP=(NEW,CATLG) and deleting it by DISP=(OLD,DELETE)
shapes: BDLD jcl/BDLDUT3.jcl ALC070: EXEC PGM=IEFBR14, DD NEWDD DISP=(NEW,CATLG)
BDLD jcl/BDLDUT3.jcl DEL080: EXEC PGM=IEFBR14, DD OLDDD DISP=(OLD,DELETE) on the same DSN
asserts: Each DD names PROD.BDLD.WORKFILE: jcl_datasets rows for both, jcl_dds disp NEW / disp_normal CATLG and disp OLD / disp_normal DELETE. IEFBR14 is system supplied: no gap and no program edge into the estate.

citations.quote: The utility program IEFBR14 performs no action other than return a completion code of 0

citations.section: DD statement > DISP parameter > Normal termination disposition subparameter
citations.quote: Indicates that, if the step terminates normally, the system is to place an entry pointing to the data set in the catalog.

citations.section: DD statement > DISP parameter > Normal termination disposition subparameter
citations.quote: Indicates that the data set is no longer needed if this step terminates normally.
